title: Platelet factor 4–induced TH1-Treg polarization suppresses antitumor immunity | Science
content: The tumor microenvironment (TME) contains a number of immune-suppressive cells such as T helper 1–polarized regulatory T cells (TH1-Treg cells). However, little is known about the mechanism behind the abundant presence of TH1-Treg cells in the TME. We ...
